1. **A clear, lasting jump.** OHzK7NFoe0 ran at a steady pattern of about $163/day on weekdays and $81/day on weekends. On 2025-06-05 it rose to $815 and stayed around $780–920 a day through 2025-06-14. The one exception was 2025-06-10, when it dropped back to $81. Its post-date average was about $600/day above its prior two-week average. That is roughly 16 times its normal day-to-day variation, by far the strongest outlier of any value in any column.
2. **It shifted on its own.** It belongs entirely to application ndE in cloud service F5v7D. ndE was the application with the largest increase (about +$684/day), and nearly all of that came from OHzK7NFoe0. ndE's other instance families held their usual levels or kept their usual swings.
